title: Make the doors' scribing-debt counter see archived cells
action: drivers::scribing_debt (packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/drivers/close.rs:347) enumerates through guard.rs:175 list_cells, which `continue`s on every directory entry (guard.rs:181-182) and so never opens .bee/cells/archive/<feature>/*.json. Because `bee close` archives a feature's cells on a green close, the count is structurally zero from that moment on and a clear door is indistinguishable from a paid debt (measured: doc-viewer-links closed with 'door scribing-debt: clear' while both of its behavior_change cells were uncaptured). Make the debt enumeration archive-aware: read the feature's hot cells AND .bee/cells/archive/<feature>/*.json, deduplicating by cell id with the LIVE copy winning — the exact pattern verbs/knowledge/promote.rs:353-376 already uses and verbs/knowledge/tests.rs:682 already pins. Do it without changing the generic guard.rs list_cells contract that other callers rely on: either add an archive-aware variant beside it or take an explicit include_archived argument that only the debt counter passes true (no other caller changes behavior). The threshold logic (best_scribing_stamp_ms, close.rs:275) is untouched — an archived cell is counted exactly when its capped_at is newer than the feature's best stamp, same as a hot one.

truths: A capped behavior_change cell living only under .bee/cells/archive/<feature>/ counts as debt when its capped_at is newer than the feature's best scribing stamp
bee close's door detail, scribing_debt_close_door and scribing_debt_swap_door all report that same debt, because all three read this one counter
A cell id present in BOTH the hot dir and the archive is counted once, with the live copy's own trace deciding
An archived cell older than the feature's best stamp stays uncounted
bee cells list, bee cells ready and every other guard.rs list_cells caller keep their active-only behavior

artifacts.substantive: scribing_debt enumerates hot + archived cells with live-copy-wins dedup; no TODO stubs
tests plant cells directly under .bee/cells/archive/<feature>/ and assert the door counts them

key_links: close.rs scribing_debt reads the archive the way knowledge/promote.rs:353-376 already does
set_gate.rs's two doors keep calling drivers::scribing_debt rather than a second copy

trace.outcome: scribing_debt now walks .bee/cells/archive/<feature>/ with live-copy-wins dedup, so an archived behavior_change cell still counts against the door
